title: News report: survivors of the plane crash at Jamaica Hospital

tellings.quote: they have received here at Jamaica Hospital, they've received 14 survivors from the plane crash.

plain: An unnamed news reporter, heard in a clip on the show, says that Jamaica Hospital in New York "received 14 survivors from the plane crash." The clip comes up in an episode with a guest named Jason Jorjani about what he says was Hitler's secret UFO program, and the clip itself does not say which crash it was or when it happened.
